articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Juniper Square’s AI CRM Deal With eVestment Might Change The Case For Investing In Nasdaq (NDAQ). In January 2026, Juniper Square announced the next phase of its partnership with Nasdaq, embedding Nasdaq’s eVestment institutional investor intelligence platform directly into Juniper Square’s AI CRM for Investor Relations to give IR teams real-time access to more than 0.10 billion investor and consultant contacts across over 30,000 profiles without extra integration work. articles.mainIdea: Leverate Launches Fully Managed MT4/MT5 Ecosystem with 3 Months Free
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Leverate Launches Fully Managed MT4/MT5 Ecosystem with 3 Months Free. DUBAI, United Arab Emirates, Jan. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Industry-first initiative combines zero-cost trial with comprehensive operational infrastructure, allowing brokers to launch and scale without technical complexity or upfront investment.Leverate is redefining how brokers launch and operate MT4/MT5 by introducing a fully managed brokerage solution with three months of free access. For the first time, brokers can go live, onboard real clients, execute real trades, and generate revenue
